newsitem.title: GREECE: INTERNATIONAL LIFE SAYS 96 NET UP 196PCT AT 240MLN.
newsitem.headline: INTERNATIONAL LIFE SAYS 96 NET UP 196PCT AT 240MLN.

text.p: Insurer International Life Group said on Thursday its fiscal 1996 profit rose 196 percent to 240 million drachmas, its president Fokion Bravos told a press conference.

"International Life's fifth balance sheet shows the company has become profitable in its fifth operating year compared to an average of seven to 12 years it takes life insurance companies to turn profitable," Bravos told reporters.
In 1996 the company settled 97.5 percent of claims which numbered 4,452 -- a quality indicator, he said.

The group's subsidiary, International Fund Management saw its fixed income fund lead its category with a three-year return of 65.6 percent. Assets under management rose 108 percent in 1996 compared to a market average growth rate of 42 percent, he said.
Its two mutual funds are in the top tier in terms of returns in the first two months of this year.
International Life will sponsor World Wide Fund For Nature's (WWF) magazine for one year. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
